title: 2013 AMC 8 Problem 9
statement: The Incredible Hulk can double the distance he jumps with each succeeding jump. If his first jump is \(1\) meter, the second jump is \(2\) meters, the third jump is \(4\) meters, and so on, then on which jump will he first be able to jump more than \(1\) kilometer?

solutions.text:
On the \(n\)th jump, the Hulk jumps \(2^{n-1}\) meters. We need the smallest \(n\) for which \(2^{n-1}>1000\).

Since \(2^9=512\) and \(2^{10}=1024\), the first jump longer than \(1000\) meters has \(n-1=10\), so \(n=11\).

Thus, C is the correct answer.
